ns2:section.sectionText: Long title: History and Techniques of Letterpress Printing. Meets last week of SS1 and continues into the first week of SS2: Monday-Friday, June 2-13. Class will meet the first day, June 2, in the Soybean Press at the Printing Services Building, 54 E. Gregory, Champaign. The next three days (June 3, 4, 5) the class will meet in the Rare Books & Manuscripts Library (Room 346 Main Library); the remaining classes will meet at the Soybean Press. [Elective course for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.uiuc.edu/programs/mbms/certificate.html)]. Contact Marianne Steadley for permission to enroll (steadley@uiuc.edu).
